(4)
If the trust was created by a gift or bequest, an order must not be made until the end of the period of 25 years after the date when the gift or bequest took effect.

(6)
The Minister must require the applicant to publish a notice—
(a)
containing particulars of the proposed order;

(7)
The period must be not less than one month beginning with the day after the date of the notice.

(8)
The applicant must publish the notice in the manner specified by the Minister.

(10)
Before making the order, the Minister must take account of representations made in accordance with the notice.

(4)
If the Scottish Ministers propose to make such an order they must publish a notice in such manner as they think sufficient for giving information to persons they think may be interested in the endowment—
(a)
containing particulars of the proposed order;

(5)
The period must be not less than one month beginning with the day after the date of publication of the notice.

(7)
Before making an order, the Scottish Ministers—
(a)
must consider representations made in accordance with the notice;
